description.value: Once per round, Interact to mark a creature you see; until your next turn your Strikes against it ignore the first range-increment penalty.

cinderfall.incomplete: Marking a creature to ignore the first range-increment penalty against it specifically needs a target-scoped effect (an Interact action that applies an Effect to a chosen enemy, then a Strike rule reading that Effect) -- the underlying 'ignore range penalty' modifier is real in principle (real precedent: any weapon property removing the range-increment penalty applies it unconditionally, never per-marked-target), but the per-target marking half of this card has no rule-element representation, so the whole thing is flagged rather than half-built.
